newsitem.title: SPAIN: Retail investors allotted minimum 10 Repsol shares.
newsitem.headline: Retail investors allotted minimum 10 Repsol shares.

text.p: The pro-rata distribution of shares in Repsol guarantees a minimum of ten shares per retail investor in the public offering, Spanish state holding company Sepi said on Tuesday.

Late Monday Sepi set the price for retail investors at 5,803 pesetas per share and for institutional investors at 6,010 pesetas per share in this last privatisation of a 10.0 percent stake in the energy group.
The offering for a total 30,002,859 shares was finally assigned as follows, Sepi said:
The remaining shares were divided between former and current Repsol employees and the underwriters of the placement.
The minimum assignation of 10 shares covered 50 percent of the retail tranche, while the rest was shared out proportionally according to the terms set out in the prospectus.
